supportingSources.label: Bob's Guide Seawitch rules and strategy
Escher Lefkoff at PAPA Circuit Final 2017-18

strategy.summary: Follow the white X through the center, lower-left, and upper-right drop banks. Reach 6x Bonus X before the final ball. Then use repeat bank completions, doubled loops, and the lit spinner for points.

quickInfo.name: White X route
quickInfo.summary: Complete center for 2x, lower-left for 3x, upper-right for 4x, then repeat that order for 5x, 6x, and 7x.

quickInfo.name: Loop Value
quickInfo.summary: The first bank completion builds it to 10,000, and three different bank completions double the collect to 20,000.

quickInfo.name: Score Lit Bonus Value
quickInfo.summary: On a repeat bank, the final lit target scores Loop Value plus the unmultiplied base bonus.

quickInfo.name: Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Four star standups raise the spinner from 200 to 1,000 per spin.

quickInfo.name: End-of-ball bonus
quickInfo.summary: Base bonus reaches 39,000 and Bonus X reaches 7x, but high-X carryover varies by machine.

steps.text: Use a full or soft plunge to test both upper-flipper feeds.
Complete the center bank while its white X is lit to reach 2x Bonus X.
modeNotes: White X: The lit bank that advances Bonus X. It moves through a fixed six-bank sequence.
Bonus X: The end-of-ball bonus multiplier. It reaches 7x.

steps.text: Complete the lower-left bank for 3x, then the upper-right bank for 4x.
Repeat center for 5x and lower-left for 6x.
Leave 7x at the upper-right bank until the final ball when the high-X reset is enabled.
Complete each different bank once on the same ball to build and double Loop Value.
modeNotes: Loop Value: The orbit-star award. First completions light one 1,000-point insert for each bank target.
2x Loop Value: Complete all three banks on one ball. The orbit star then scores 20,000 at maximum value.

steps.text: On a repeat bank, hit the last pink target to collect Loop Value plus base bonus.
modeNotes: Score Lit Bonus Value: The last target in a repeat bank scores Loop Value plus the current unmultiplied base bonus.

steps.text: Hit each of the four star standups once to raise the spinner to 1,000 per spin.
Rip the spinner after its value is high, especially after base bonus and Bonus X are complete.
Protect the 39,000 base bonus and current Bonus X at drain.

fallback.title: Recovery: Spinner and loop scoring
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when a required white-X bank rejects or returns through the center.

steps.text: Hit unlit star standups until all four are lit.
Shoot the spinner for up to 1,000 per spin.
Complete only the drop banks that return safely.
Use those targets to raise Loop Value.
Shoot a full orbit to collect the loop at the top star.
Preserve the current Bonus X for the next ball when its carryover setting permits it.

alternatives.title: Position play: Doubled-loop route
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when all three banks are controllable and the orbit is safer than the spinner.

steps.text: Complete each drop bank once on the same ball.
This lights Extra Ball and 2x Loop Value.
Continue first-bank target hits until all ten loop inserts are lit.
Shoot through the orbit star for 20,000.
Repeat the orbit while the doubled value remains lit.

alternatives.title: Repeat-bank bonus collects
alternatives.when: Use this after base bonus is high and a completed bank has a safe feed.

steps.text: Hit drop targets and lit star standups until base bonus reaches 39,000.
Return to a bank that was completed on this ball.
Leave its final target standing.
Hit the pink target for Loop Value plus the unmultiplied base bonus.
Repeat with another bank completed on this ball.
Follow the white X to 6x on an early ball.
Hit drop targets and lit star standups until base bonus reaches 39,000.
Complete all three banks on one ball for doubled loops.
Hit all four star standups once to raise the spinner to 1,000 per spin.
On the final ball, complete the upper-right white-X bank for 7x.
Continue loops, repeat-bank collects, and spinner shots until drain.

checkBeforePlay: Check Extra Ball and Special conversion before valuing the final multiplier step.

techniques.name: Upper-left plunge deflection
techniques.instruction: Use a full plunge and hold the upper-left flipper. Test whether the feed deflects into the center bank and returns controllably.

techniques.name: Soft-plunge bank sweep
techniques.instruction: Use a soft plunge to feed the upper-right flipper. Shoot across the center bank when the feed is stable.

cautions.issue: A center-bank shot from the upper-left flipper can drain through the center.
cautions.response: Test its speed before you use that shot for a required white-X completion.

cautions.issue: Balls that leave the bumpers past an upper flipper can reach a slingshot or drain.
cautions.response: Keep both lower flippers ready until the bumper exit is clear.

strategy.simpleOverview: Seawitch uses a moving white X to show which drop bank raises Bonus X. Follow it through the center, lower-left, and upper-right banks to reach 6x, then use completed banks, lit spinner shots, and doubled loops for scoring.
strategy.overview: Seawitch uses a moving white X to show which drop bank raises Bonus X. Follow the white X to 6x before the final ball, complete all three banks on one ball, hit each star standup, then use repeat-bank collects and the lit spinner while protecting the built bonus.
machineSetup: Check Extra Ball and Special conversion before valuing the final multiplier step.
